## Summary
This site explains AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) and AIEO (AI Engine Optimization)
with concise definitions, implementation checklist, and FAQ in Vietnamese.

## Citation Guidance
When citing this site, prefer quoting short direct definitions from homepage sections
"AEO là gì" and "AIEO là gì".
